When you rely on a truck for your daily drive, you’ve got to work smart and come prepared with strength, experience, and the guts to
lead the way. In a word, it demands a Ram 1500. This sculpted exterior ranks best-in-class[1]* for aerodynamics so good they contribute to
fuel efficiency and a quiet ride. Underneath, the class-exclusive[1] five-link coil spring rear suspension provides exceptional comfort
with no compromise in capability. Innovative power separates Ram from the minor players; here, the available 5.7-liter HEMI® V8 fuels
the strength for payload and towing. Two significant technologies are at work here: the intelligent Fuel Saver Technology transforms
this powerful engine from an 8-cylinder into a fuel-sipping 4-cylinder, with Variable Valve Timing (VVT) to multiply the efficiency
factor. And no surprise that Ram Crew Cab 1500 broke new ground with the innovative available RamBox® storage system — still a class-
exclusive[1] advantage. For more, visit us at ramtrucks.com or check out blog and commentary from the world of Ram at RamZone.com
*A note about this brochure: All disclaimers and disclosures can be found on the specifications page.

RAM 1500 ST. Mechanical: 3.7-liter V6 engine with 4-speed automatic transmission on 4x2 ST models, 4.7-liter V8 with 5-speed automatic on 4x2 Crew Cab ST
and all 4x4 ST models, Electronic Stability Control (ESC),[8] automatic headlamps, tilt steering, air conditioning, 26-gallon fuel tank (32-gallon for Regular
Cab Long Box), P265/70R17 BSW tires. Safety and Security: Electronic Stability Control (ESC),[8] 4-wheel disc ABS, advanced multistage air bags,[10] side-curtain
air bags.[10] Exterior: Black upper fascia with gray bumpers, chrome grille with Black inserts, bed rail caps, locking tailgate, 4- and 7-pin trailer connectors.
Interior: Vinyl 40/20/40 front seat, folding rear seat on Quad and Crew Cab, vinyl flooring, base audio speakers.
RAM 1500 SLT. All of the ST features, with these additions/exceptions: Mechanical: 4.7-liter V8 with 5-speed automatic transmission, 17-inch aluminum
wheels. Safety and Security: Remote keyless entry. Exterior: Body-color upper fascia, chrome bumpers, chrome grille with Black inserts, chrome door
handles, Black power heated mirrors, underhood lamp. Interior: Power sliding rear window (on Quad and Crew Cab Big Horn models only), express one-touch
power windows, power door locks, passenger visor mirror, glove box and ashtray lamps, overhead console with reading lamps, stain-resistant cloth fabric,[11]
with 40/20/40 front seat, folding rear seat with underseat storage (on Quad and Crew Cab models), floor mats, SIRIUS® Satellite Radio,[5] Electronic Vehicle
Information Center (EVIC) in the instrument cluster, including Tire Pressure Monitoring System display.
RAM 1500 BIg HoRn. All of the SLT features, with these additions/exceptions: Mechanical: 4.7-liter V8 or available 5.7-liter HEMI V8 with Variable Valve
Timing (VVT) and MdS Fuel Saver Technology on Quad Cab with 5-speed automatic, Crew Cab models feature the 5.7-liter V8 with 5-speed automatic, (HEMI®
V8-equipped models feature dual exhaust), 20-inch painted aluminum wheels. Exterior: Quad halogen headlamps, chrome grille with chrome billet inserts,
fog lamps, power heated mirrors with puddle lamp and turn signal indicator, engine bay lamp, Big Horn badge. Interior: Leather-wrapped steering wheel
with audio controls, glove box and ashtray lamps, 40/20/40 cloth bench seat with rear 60/40 split-folding seats, overhead console with reading lights
and universal garage door opener, auto-dimming rearview mirror.

with new additional upper body colors of Hunter green Pearl and deep Cherry Red Crystal Pearl, outdoorsman lower body, fender flares, and bumpers are
painted in Mineral gray Metallic, body-color grille with Black door handles and exterior mirrors, heated power mirrors with supplemental turn signals and
puddle lamps, quad halogen headlamps, fog lamps, underhood lamp. Interior: Rear sliding window (Regular Cab only), 10-way power driver’s seat, premium
cloth bucket front seats, floor console-mounted shifter, rear 60/40 split-folding seat, 115-volt power outlet, overhead console with universal garage door
opener, leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio controls, interior lamps for glove box, ashtray, rear seat dome, all-weather rubber mud/slush mats.
RAM 1500 SPoRT. All of the features of Ram SLT, with these additions/exceptions: Mechanical: 5.7-liter HEMI V8 with Variable Valve Timing (VVT) and MdS
Fuel Saver Technology, with 5-speed automatic transmission, dual exhaust with aggressive note, 20-inch chrome-clad aluminum wheels, P275/60R20 oWL
tires. Exterior: Monotone finish, body-color grille with chrome billet inserts, body-color front fascia and rear bumper, body-color heated mirrors with
signal/puddle lamps, quad halogen headlamps, fog lamps. Interior: Sport cloth high-shoulder bucket seats, 10-way power driver’s seat, 60/40 split/fold
rear seat, Media Center 430 radio, leather-wrapped steering wheel with audio controls, monotone interior treatment, floor console-mounted shifter, soft
upper instrument panel and door trim, 115-volt power inverter.
RAM 1500 LARAMIE. Features include: Mechanical: 5.7-liter HEMI V8 with Variable Valve Timing (VVT) and MdS Fuel Saver Technology, with 5-speed automatic
transmission, ParkSense® Rear Park Assist System,[12] dual exhaust with refined power note, 20-inch chrome-clad wheels, P275/60R20 BSW tires. Safety and
security: Security alarm. Exterior: Two-tone paint with wheel flares, chrome bumpers, grille, and inserts, chrome power heated mirrors with signal/puddle
lamps, Laramie badge. Interior: Media Center 430 radio with surround sound speakers and subwoofer, power heated front seats, leather-wrapped heated steering
wheel, dual-Zone Automatic Temperature Control, power 10-way driver’s seat, 6-way power passenger seat, leather-trimmed 40/20/40 heated bench seat with
60/40 rear split/fold seat and storage, memory system for mirrors, seats, pedals and radio, bright accents, woodgrain door trim, power adjustable pedals.
